decision: ENV-U10 (user, 2026-09-30): themed CC0 ground between the map frame and the tray edge - Marmoreal: marble paving by the palace + dark earth with petals; Sarpedon: forest floor, sand, ship deck planks under the ship, pebbles at the river mouth. ENV-U5: only the downloaded CC0 sets (the +10 sets / +300 MB of ENV-U5 are used up: 10 sets, 282 MB; neither ambientCG nor Poly Haven has a CC0 water normal) - the P4 water ripple normal is procedural (ue_import_env_ground.py --prep).

tools.import: tools/art/env_kit/ue_import_env_ground.py (--prep: CC0 -> 2K BC/N/ORMH staging PNGs; UE: textures, M_EnvGround, MI_EnvGround_<Map>)
tools.aux: ground_splat.py also writes <map>.aux.png (RGBA8, the splat grid: R water, G foam, B edge band (Marmoreal curb / Sarpedon deck beam), A = 1 + water depth * 254) and the layout 'ground.waterfalls'

tray.source: P2 shared tray of both maps (track TRAY default; C:/tmp/envmaps-research/p2/tray-extents.json). ground_splat.py warns when that file or a layout tray disagrees.

splat.note: RGBA8, linear. R/G/B = coverage of layers L1/L2/L3 stacked over the base L0 (L3 on top), A = accent density (Marmoreal petals, Sarpedon wetness). The texture covers splatRect = tray rect (union of this tray and the layout tray) + marginUU, rounded outward; row 0 = the far side (-Y), column 0 = -X.

material.note: heightBlend per layer L1..L3 (0..1) scales how much the layer's height shapes its border; accent.carpet = the pink carpet strength under dense petals (petals mode only). P4 (graph 2), optional per layer: roughMin / roughScale (roughness = max(tex * roughScale, roughMin)), specular (default material.specular), normalStrength (x material.normalStrength), macro (extra +-value noise at layerMacroScaleUU on that layer only, ~ one paving tile). Per map: edge = the aux.B band (albedo x color, roughness -> roughness, strength), water = the aux.R/G/A water layer (Sarpedon river mouths), rules = splat-rule numbers (ground_splat.py; every number has a code default).

trayLook.role: P5 track B (ENV-U10 'скалистый край', ONE shared tray): the look of SM_TableBase_T2b (lane K) = M_TableBase_T2b (the T2 rock graph of M_UM_Figure + a moss lerp by VertexColor.R, B = depth darkening, G = per-chunk variation) - tools/art/env_kit/ue_import_tray_t2.py builds MI_TableBase_T2b (these defaults) and MI_TableBase_T2b_<Map> (defaults + maps.<key>.trayLook); the board actor takes the map's MI (S08Diorama::LoadTrayT2Material). Status: proposed (no art acceptance). At MossAmount 0 / white tints / variation 0 / depth and petal alpha 0 the material equals the T2 look.

Tiles143.note: square travertine tiles (beige) - desaturated to pale marble paving

moss under the cherries, round the cypresses, along the tray rim and the paving edge
grass tufts in the outer W / E beds
marble paving: palace terrace N, walkway round the frame, lamp / plinth pads; a 1-tile curb band (aux.B edge) along its border to the earth / moss

edge.role: curb: the outermost paving tile row, darker and rougher (review gap 10)

rules.note: review gaps 10 / 13 (P4): noise-broken, blurred paving edge + 1-tile curb; petals masked round the cherries and the colonnade beds, global confetti x0.5

trayLook.note: moss on the upper lip with cherry petals in it (the ground accent colour), the palace-garden green

layers.role: forest floor (base; W / NW) - darker (review gap 7: concept Y ~26 against 54)
sand: beach N-centre, river banks, fire clearings (warmer, review gap 5)
pebbles: a thin, brighter rim round the water of both river mouths, fort rubble, beach scatter
ship deck planks: E band under the hull and cannons, quay N-E and S-E; a beam (aux.B edge) where the planks end

river.source: measured on the map illustration (scraped-data/images/maps/sarpedon.webp, out of git): water runs x at the map edges, board uu

edge.role: deck beam: the timber edge where the planks end (review gap 5)

water.role: review gap 1: water at both river mouths (N beach -> sea surf, S -> waterfall over the near tray edge), tinted to the map's river colour; drawn by M_EnvGround from aux.R/G/A, the falls are engine-plane cards (S08EnvGround waterfalls, M_EnvWaterfall) || P5c track W: whiter foam (0.62, 0.66, 0.7) -> (0.78, 0.83, 0.88) on the river mouths and the waterfall (both read WaterFoam); the river water itself stays M_EnvGround (the pack's M_Rapids would need its own strip meshes at the mouths - not in this stage)

mesh.note: P5 track B: the lane K meshes replace the vertical plane card (the spill plane stays): sheet (FallCard from the build), foam + mist (slot MIDs, kind 1), the optional rock lip (MI_TableBase_T2b_<Map>); the plane card is the fallback while the sheet mesh is not imported

look.note: P5c track W (P5b review: chunky masked streaks, hard rectangular outline): M_EnvWaterfall graph 3 is lit translucent (per-pixel surface lighting) - a clear-ish body (bodyOpacity) with nearly opaque foam / streaks (foamOpacity), side fades whose width wobbles along the flow (edgeWobble), the Water Materials T_Waterfall_Foam streaks in two layers (pack, packTileUU across / along, packSpeedRatio); blend 'masked' = the graph 2 dithered look through an MI blend-mode override (fallback without a code change)

sea.role: P5 track B (review gap 8, Sarpedon only): the dark sea ring under the island (lane K SM_Env_S_SeaRing: Col.R foam band at the cliffs, Col.G far fade, UV0 = board XY / 600 uu) with M_EnvSea / MI_EnvSea_<Map> (tools/art/env_kit/ue_import_env_ground.py); placed by S08EnvGround from the layout ground.sea at (0, tray offsetY, the fall bottom z) || P5c track W (P5b review: no waves / surf, the foam band read as grey fog, the background a flat dark navy): M_EnvSea graph 2 - still opaque - samples the Water Materials pack (tharlevfx, CC BY 4.0: T_Ocean_Foam lace, T_Water_Normal / _Large waves; pack false or a missing pack = the procedural graph 1 lace): a sharper, whiter shore band (shoreSharpness / shoreThreshold), surf crest lines running in towards the cliffs (surf: spacing, cycles / s, reach from the inner ring edge = the lane K UV1 distance, V flipped by the FBX import), facet shade + sparse whitecaps from the wave normals (waves), foamLift = the foam's own emissive lift (was the water lift 3.0), and a dim night-sky reflection with slow cloud variation on the far sea (sky; the only background the opaque ring leaves visible). Status: предложено (values to be measured in UE frames). || P5c tune (UE frames): sky.intensity 1.0 -> 1.8 - the background band round the tray at K1x0.65 17.8 -> 20.9 luma (target ~20-26, P4 25.5), texture std 5.2 (P5b 2.15).
